interface.title: ChemInfo Dashboard
interface.field: Cheminformatics / medicinal chemistry / LC-MS method development
interface.stage_of_work: Compound triage and analytical method design (before synthesis, screening or LC-MS/MS experiments)
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a compound (SMILES, or a name/CAS via PubChem) or a CSV/Excel list of compounds into RDKit descriptors, Lipinski/Veber/Ghose/Egan drug-likeness verdicts, functional-group counts, adduct m/z values and suggested MRM transitions, with CSV/PNG export.

data.note: Single-compound work used typed SMILES: aspirin CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O, a 39-carbon chain ending in chlorine (Cl), designed to fail every rule, and the invalid 'C1CC(XX'. Batch work used batch_compounds_smiles.csv, which has 9 rows (Compound, SMILES): 8 were analysed, 7 succeeded and 'C1CC(XX' was reported as invalid; the blank row was dropped without a message. Chemical Name and CAS lookups were tried once each and failed with a PubChem proxy error (no network).

tree.general: Characterise candidate compounds for drug-likeness and plan a targeted mass-spec assay for them
tree.specific: Compute RDKit descriptors, Lipinski/Veber/Ghose/Egan verdicts, functional groups and MRM transitions for one compound or a CSV of SMILES, and export the results

features.name: Structure-string input with validation
features.general: Type a structure string and an optional label, submit it with Enter or a button, and either get a report or an inline error naming the malformed string
features.specific: SMILES String mode: SMILES box plus optional compound name, submitted with Enter or >> Analyze; invalid input shows 'Invalid SMILES: <string>' and no report; an empty name gives the header 'Unknown'
steps: type the SMILES and optionally a name
get the report, or read the inline 'Invalid SMILES' error
serves_tasks: Enter one structure directly as a line-notation string

features.name: Compound summary header
features.general: Show a drawing of the molecule that can be enlarged, a row of headline-number cards, and a tab bar leading to the detailed tables
features.specific: RDKit 2D depiction with a 'Fullscreen: 2D Structure' button, 8 metric cards (MW, LogP, PSA, QED, HBD, HBA, RotBonds, Rings; long values are cut off), and the Properties / Classification / Drug-Likeness / MRM / Functional Groups / References / Export tabs
steps: read the drawing and the metric cards
open the Properties tab for full, untruncated values
serves_tasks: Read the drawn structure, the headline descriptors and the full descriptor table

features.name: Functional-group detector
features.general: Match a molecule against a fixed list of substructure patterns and list each group found with its count
features.specific: Functional Groups tab: Group/Count table (e.g. Hydroxyl, Carboxyl, Ester, Ether, Aromatic Ring, Secondary Amine, Halogen (Cl))
steps: read the group names and counts
serves_tasks: Look up which chemical groups the molecule contains

features.name: Multi-rule pass/fail checklist
features.general: Score one item against several named rule sets and show each as a collapsible panel with an overall PASS/FAIL in its title, a per-criterion PASS/FAIL table and a violation count
features.specific: Drug-Likeness tab: Lipinski Rule of 5 (with violation count), Veber, Ghose and Egan expanders, each listing its thresholds and PASS/FAIL
steps: scan the PASS/FAIL in each expander title
expand or collapse a rule to see which criterion failed
serves_tasks: Check a compound against several rule sets, criterion by criterion

features.name: MRM transition planner
features.general: From a molecule's exact mass, list the expected ions in both polarities, predict neutral-loss fragments chosen from the groups present, and propose precursor→product pairs with an estimated energy and a quantifier/qualifier role, plus an isotope-pattern warning for halogens
features.specific: MRM / Mass Spec tab: monoisotopic and average mass cards, positive and negative adduct tables, predicted fragment ions (H2O/CO/CO2/HCOOH/NH3/HCl losses), a Suggested MRM Transitions table with Est. CE (eV) and Quantifier/Qualifier, and a Cl/Br isotope note
steps: read the adduct m/z values for each polarity
read the suggested transitions and CE
serves_tasks: Get exact masses and expected ion m/z values in both polarities
Get suggested precursor-to-product transitions with collision energies
Check the expected isotope pattern for halogens

features.name: Spreadsheet batch import with column mapping
features.general: Upload a CSV/Excel file, preview its rows, pick which column holds the identifiers and what kind they are, then run all rows with a progress bar and a success/failure summary
features.specific: Batch Upload (CSV/Excel): upload, see 'Loaded N rows' and a preview table, choose a column in 'Select the column with compound names/SMILES', set 'Column contains' to Compound Names or SMILES, press >> Analyze, and get 'Analyzing i/N' then 'Successfully analyzed 7 / 8' with invalid rows listed

press Analyze and watch the progress bar
read the success count and the error messages

features.name: Batch results table with drill-down picker
features.general: Show all processed items in one sortable, scrollable table, with a dropdown that opens any single item's full report below it; the batch results survive reruns
features.specific: Batch Analysis table (sort by clicking a column header, scroll sideways through the descriptors) plus 'Select compound for detailed view', which shows that compound's structure, cards and all tabs

serves_tasks: Compare compounds side by side in one combined table

screens_never_reached: Name/CAS lookup results (structure, synonyms and properties from PubChem): every lookup failed with 'Error querying PubChem … ProxyError' because the sandbox has no network (screens/003.webp, screens/004.webp)

Filled Classification tab (pharmacological group, ATC codes, mechanism) and References/PubChem links: these need PubChem data, so offline they only show info messages (screens/010.webp, screens/018.webp)
Batch mode with 'Column contains: Compound Names': not run, because it needs PubChem and sample_compounds.csv has names only
not_done: Looking up a known drug by name or CAS number did not work: PubChem was unreachable (proxy 403), so that goal stopped at the error banner.

Single-compound export resets the page: each download button clears the result back to the welcome screen (screens/019.webp), so you must press >> Analyze again before each of the three downloads. Batch results stay on screen after downloading.

Batch output loses the names from the file: the Compound column and the detailed-view dropdown show SMILES instead of the 'Compound' names (Aspirin, Caffeine…), and a batch compound's own export is saved as 'Unknown_…'.
The blank row in the batch file was dropped without any message (9 rows loaded, 8 analysed).
The Batch Analysis table's sort order is not kept: after picking a compound in the detailed-view dropdown the table returns to its original order (found on replay).
Light Mode toggle: the interactive tables (batch results and preview) turn blank or unreadable (screens/041.webp, screens/042.webp), so I switched back to dark mode.
The data-table toolbar (Search, Show/hide columns, Download as CSV, Fullscreen) is in the page structure, but clicking Search timed out and the toolbar never showed on hover, so I could not use it.
The metric cards cut long values to '18…' or '1.…'; the full values are only in the Properties table.
The downloaded PNG's contents were not checked, because the file reader reports only the size of binary files.
Drug-likeness PASS/FAIL verdicts are not in any export: neither the single nor the batch properties CSV has rule-result columns.
